Definition
[Kleinian quotient spaces] \group Kleinian groupsSource: thurston:page-0194, thurston:page-0195 Write \[ M_\Gamma =H(L_\Gamma )/\Gamma ,\quad N_\Gamma =H^n/\Gamma ,\quad O_\Gamma =(H^n\cup D_\Gamma )/\Gamma ,\quad P_\Gamma =(H^n\cup D_\Gamma \cup W_\Gamma )/\Gamma , \] where $W_\Gamma $ is the projective set dual to planes whose ideal boundary lies in $D_\Gamma $. There are inclusions $M_\Gamma \subset N_\Gamma \subset O_\Gamma \subset P_\Gamma $; the first three have the same homotopy type, $N_\Gamma =\Int (O_\Gamma )$, and $M_\Gamma ,O_\Gamma $ are homeomorphic outside degenerate cases.
